exposure: counselling on timely initiation of breastfeeding during antenatal care
cohort: 307 Turkish mothers with healthy children up to 3 years old
finding: Timely initiation of breastfeeding was associated with residence, type of delivery, type of anaesthesia, birth weight, counselling on timely initiation of breastfeeding during antenatal care and consultant medical staff.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery and spinal/epidural anaesthesia were associated with timely initiation of breastfeeding.
